description: Test file for validation functions related to API server internal storage versions in Kubernetes, including tests for validation of server storage version objects, status, conditions, and version names.

methods.name: TestValidateServerStorageVersion
methods.description: Unit test for validating ServerStorageVersion objects, checking for invalid IDs, missing encoding version, invalid version strings, and version inclusion constraints.

methods.name: TestValidateStorageVersionStatus
methods.description: Unit test for validating StorageVersionStatus objects, ensuring no duplicate API server IDs.

methods.name: TestValidateCommonVersion
methods.description: Unit test for validating the common encoding version consistency across storage versions.

methods.name: TestValidateStorageVersionCondition
methods.description: Unit test for validating StorageVersionCondition objects, checking for invalid types, statuses, and duplicate conditions.

methods.name: TestValidateStorageVersionName
methods.description: Unit test for validating the format of storage version names, including group and resource segments length constraints.
